Prelaunch.metaTitle: Ruta Opta · Talent and community tourism in Colombia
Prelaunch.metaDescription: Ruta Opta connects people's talent with opportunities in Quindío, Risaralda, Caldas, Valle del Cauca and Chocó. Grow, create and connect.
Prelaunch.ogAlt: Ruta Opta: “The talent in communities can transform their territories”, over a paper-relief coffee valley with the Ruta Opta sun.
Prelaunch.ogTitle: The talent in communities can transform their territories
Prelaunch.ogDescription: We connect the talent in communities with opportunities in the Coffee Region, Valle del Cauca and Chocó.
Prelaunch.title: The talent in communities can transform their territories.
Prelaunch.lead: Ruta Opta connects people's talent with opportunities in Quindío, Risaralda, Caldas, Valle del Cauca and Chocó. We listen, recognize, connect and build with them.

thesis.title: There is talent in every territory
thesis.text: Communities already know how to cook, farm, guide, create and organize. What is often missing is opportunities reaching them. Ruta Opta exists to bring the two closer, and so that decisions stay with the people who live there.
thesis.stance: Communities should not have to get used to others deciding for them.

Prelaunch.methodTitle: Grow, create, connect: a path in three steps

grow.name: Grow
grow.tagline: Recognize who I am, what I feel and what I can contribute.
grow.text: We strengthen people: well-being, confidence and recognition of what they already know how to do.

create.name: Create
create.tagline: Turn knowledge and talents into proposals.
create.text: We help you put costs, a price and a good presentation on what you already know how to do.

connect.name: Connect
connect.tagline: Present proposals to the people who can buy and support them.
connect.text: We open contact with visitors, allies and markets.

tourism.title: Turismo Vivo: rural experiences designed by the people who live there
tourism.text: Tourism experiences designed by the people who live in the territory: a meal, a walk, a craft. Each family decides what to share and how, and the price and how it is shared are known before anything is sold. We are building it together with the communities.

places.title: Five territories, one route
places.lead: From the coffee mountains to the Pacific rainforest, every territory has its own knowledge.
places.quindio: Wax palms, coffee and bahareque towns.
places.risaralda: Cloud forests, guadua bamboo and hot springs.
places.caldas: Coffee mountains at the foot of the Nevado del Ruiz.
places.valle: The Cauca river valley, between the Andes and the Pacific.
places.choco: Rainforest, rivers and the Pacific coast.

what.a: An initiative of Fundación Embajadores de la Paz that connects people's talent with opportunities in Quindío, Risaralda, Caldas, Valle del Cauca and Chocó.

how.a: In three steps: grow, to strengthen people; create, to turn their knowledge into proposals with costs, a price and a good presentation; and connect, to present those proposals to visitors, allies and markets.

tourism.a: Rural experiences designed by the people who live in the territory: a meal, a walk, a craft. Each family decides what to share and how, and the price and how it is shared are known before anything is sold.

book.q: Can I book an experience yet?
book.a: Not yet. Turismo Vivo is being built together with the communities. Leave us your email and we will let you know when it opens.

allies.q: How can I become an ally?
allies.a: Write to us on WhatsApp or at info@rutaopta.org and tell us who you are and how you would like to take part.

data.q: What do you do with my data?
data.a: We use your name and email only to send you Ruta Opta news and to let you know when we open. You can unsubscribe at any time from any email. The details are in our data processing policy.

Privacy.title: Data protection policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data the OPTA waitlist collects, what we use it for and how you can exercise your rights.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.text: Fundación Embajadores de la Paz, responsible for OPTA, NIT 901679710-4, based at Carrera 13 #2N-49, Torre Fundadores 202, Armenia, Quindío. Legal representative: Stephania Forero. Phone: +57 310 587 4657.

data.title: What data we ask for
data.text: Your name and your email address. We keep them until you unsubscribe; after that we keep them only so we never email you again.

purpose.title: What we use it for
purpose.text: To send you news from OPTA and let you know when we open. We don't use it for anything else.

processor.title: Who helps us send the emails
processor.text: We send newsletters with Zoho Campaigns and confirmation emails with Zoho CPaaS, both from Zoho Corporation. The site is hosted on Netlify. These providers may store data on servers outside Colombia.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can access, update and correct your data, ask us to delete it and withdraw your authorization at any time. You can also use the unsubscribe link in every email.
